title: How a new wave of science philanthropists can have the greatest impact
title_zh: 科技企业家如何以工程师视角最大化科研资助影响力
abstract: Tech entrepreneurs are bringing an engineer’s eye to research funding. They must be open about their findings to reap maximum benefit.
abstract_zh: 科技企业家正以工程师的视角投身科研资助。他们必须公开自己的研究成果，以获得最大的益处。
